text: vāsudattasuttaṃ [262] ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho vāsudatto devaputto bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi sattiyā viya omaṭṭho ḍayhamāneva 3 matthake kāmarāgappahānāya sato bhikkhu paribbajeti . [263] sattiyā viya omaṭṭho ḍayhamāneva matthake sakkāyadiṭṭhippahānāya sato bhikkhu paribbajeti . sattamaṃ
